title: brio competency referential
description: Controlled competency referential for one subject, traceable to the official curriculum (BOEN, attendus de fin d'année). Code grammar and freeze policy: docs/adr/0009. Uniqueness of codes and cross-field coherence (code prefix vs cycle/domaine) are enforced by scripts/check-competencies.mjs and at ingestion, not expressible here.

schemaVersion.description: Integer schema version. Bumped only on breaking structural changes.

matiere.description: Subject slug this referential covers, e.g. 'mathematiques'.

code.description: Immutable hierarchical identifier: c{cycle}.{domaine}.{theme}.{capacite} (ADR 0009). Engraved in chapters and submissions — never renamed, never reused.

intitule.description: French label of the competency, phrased as an observable capability. May quote the official programme verbatim (Licence Ouverte, source cited in referenceOfficielle).

cycle.description: Official curriculum cycle. Collège only: cycle 3 entries cover the 6e slice, cycle 4 covers 5e/4e/3e.

niveaux.description: Grade levels where the competency is worked, restricted to collège.

domaine.description: Official programme domain (full slug; the code carries its abbreviation — num, geo, gm, ogd, algo).

referenceOfficielle.description: Citation of the official source grounding this entry: BOEN issue and programme, and/or attendus de fin d'année.
